payload.title: Cost model and tags for agent resources
payload.description:
Tag every agent resource with site and responsibility. Document the unit costs (a queue message, a schedule tick, a run's Lambda time, model spend from the ledger) and show a site's monthly agent cost on its Agents page from the ledger and the tags. An idle agent must cost close to nothing: no polling, no schedule that walks a table.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A site's agent cost is visible by responsibility.
- An agent with nothing to do makes no model call.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- agent-cost.feature: an idle day shows no model spend; cost by responsibility sums to the ledger total.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Tags on queue, schedules, functions; cost attribution config.

**Part of:** Infrastructure as code and the shared tier. Slice code I3 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
